messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@datastreamevents.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, Jun 1, 2026 at 9:12 AM -0700
Subject: Staggered promo code release for DataStream webinar series

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking this — we run a four-week webinar series in July (7/6, 7/13, 7/20, 7/27) and want to offer attendees promo codes that unlock a Redwood trial. Total need is ~250 codes, but we want them released in a staggered fashion: 75 for week 1, 60 for week 2, 60 for week 3, 55 for week 4.

A few asks:
- 50 of these should be "VIP" codes (speaker/partner invites) that get a 60-day trial; the rest can be standard 30-day trials.
- Codes must be unique, single-use, and expire 90 days after issuance.
- We need a simple CSV back with redemption events (email, code, redeemed_at) and a single summary at campaign end.
- Can you confirm whether codes can be scheduled (auto-release) or whether we need to push them manually?

Attaching a preliminary VIP attendee list (filename: participant_vip_list.csv) — most are partner contacts. Please let me know any constraints (per-account caps, rate limits) we should design around.

We have a small sponsorship budget to cover trial overages if there is high uptake; if you need a PO or approval path, say so and I’ll route it.

Best,
Elena Park
Partnerships, DataStream Events
elena@datastreamevents.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@datastreamevents.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, Jun 1, 2026 at 11:03 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Staggered promo code release for DataStream webinar series

Hi Elena — thanks for the details and the VIP list, got it. We can absolutely support a staggered release; a couple quick clarifying items so Marissa (ops) and Vanessa (partner marketing) can scope the delivery: 

1) Trial entitlements: are VIPs expected to get any extra quota (tokens/hour or seat credits) beyond the 60-day extension? If so please spell out.
2) Do you want the standard codes to be 30-day and non-renewing (auto-convert to paid only via signup), or to include a 1-time welcome credit that applies toward first invoice?
3) Confirm whether you prefer automated scheduled drops (we can push codes to a hosted redemption page on schedule) or a weekly delivery file. Automated scheduling is preferred on our side; manual deliveries are possible but we need 48h notice for each batch.

Proposed default plan unless you say otherwise: issue 200 standard 30-day single-use codes + 50 VIP 60-day single-use codes; schedule releases as 75/60/60/55; provide a redemption CSV each Monday of the campaign and a final summary after 8/1.

Marissa — can your team generate the codes and prepare the schedule? Vanessa — would like you to confirm any co-branded content or landing page assets we should reference.

Elena — if you anticipate >250 redemptions or want to increase VIPs, flag it early so we can check quota and pricing.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.ai

> Proposed default plan unless you say otherwise: issue 200 standard 30-day single-use codes + 50 VIP 60-day single-use codes; schedule releases as 75/60/60/55; provide a redemption CSV each Monday of the campaign and a final summary after 8/1.

We can do this. Ops notes and constraints below: 

- Code generation: will create unique single-use alphanumeric codes; attach scheduling workbook (staggered-code-sheet.xlsx) with drop dates and code pools.
- Scheduling: we can automate drops to a hosted redemption endpoint (preferred). If DataStream wants CSV deliveries we can email the batches 24-48h prior to the webinar start time — earlier note: 48h lead time for manual pushes.
- Rate limits & per-account caps: redemption endpoint enforces a 1-code-per-account cap by email. If partners need multi-seat activations, we need that callout now.
- Reporting: ops will produce a weekly CSV (email, code, redeemed_at, plan_type) and a final summary PDF showing uptake and top domains.
- Attachments: staggered-code-sheet.xlsx (scheduling + suggested code naming), test redemption link will be staged in the Google Sheet (see link).

Please confirm: 30-day standard, 60-day VIP, single-use, 1-code-per-email. If Elena confirms, we’ll generate codes and stage them for an initial smoke test by 6/22.

Marissa Cole
Program Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Quick follow-up — thanks for drafting the plan. Two procurement items to note before ops issues the full 250: 

1) Value cap: if the combined notional value (est. redeemed usage + trial length) exceeds $7,500 we need a brief deal record and approval from Revenue Ops. Please open HUBSPOT-123456 (or send me a quick estimate) if you think we might breach that.
2) For VIP codes that map to partner seats, confirm whether DataStream expects seat-sharing arrangements (multiple users behind one org email) — that changes our entitlement checks.

Assuming the standard 1-code-per-email single-use model and estimated redemption at 25-35%, I’m okay to greenlight generation and scheduling. Ops: proceed and hold final activation until DataStream confirms whether they want scheduled drops or weekly CSV deliveries.

If Elena can confirm schedule preference by EOD Monday (6/8), we’ll plan a smoke test generation on 6/22 and full staging by 6/24.
